annotations.title: VViſdom.
annotations.text: As wel in theſe Sapiential bookes, as in other holie Scriptures, and ſacred writers, the vvord vviſdom hath three ſignifications. [1] Sometimes it importeth the Diuine Attribute called Gods wiſdom; ſometimes ſupernatural wiſdom geuen to men by the Holie Ghoſt; and ſometimes it ſignifieth mere humane vviſdom, gotten by the natural light of reaſon and mans induſtrie. [2] The firſt, as likevviſe other Diuine Attributes, Gods Povvre, Goodnes, Iuſtice, Truth, Mercie and the like, are not qualities, or other accidents in God, as the ſame termes ſignifie in creatures. For in God there is no Accident, but al in him is this Diuine Subſtance and Eſſence, vvhoſe diuers Excellences are called by ſuch names as mans capacitie can better conceiue: and ſo Gods vviſdom is God himſelfe: [3] and is appropried to the ſecond Perſon of the bleſſed Trinitie, as Povvre is appropried to God the Father, and Goodnes to the Holie Ghoſt. In this ſenſe: chap. 4. v. 16. is ſaide: Our Lord by vviſdom founded the earth &c. The ſecond is called (Sap. 3. v. 25.) the vapore of Gods povvre, and a pure emanation (or influence) of the glorie of Almightie God, and ſo is a participation of Diuine increated wiſdom called alſo diuine, according to a certaine anologie, or ſimilitude of Gods owne wiſdom, and is the principal gifte of the Holie Ghoſt, [4] by vvhich God is rightly knovvne, and duly ſerued, including al other ſupernal giftes and vertues, vvherof is treated in theſe bookes, and ſo vvhich al men are inuited, vvith aſſured promiſe of celeſtial and eternal revvard. [5] The third vviſdome is mere humane, gotten by natural vvitte and ſtudie, ſuch as Philoſophers haue, knovving manie truthes, but mixt vvith manie errors, and much ignorance, truly called vvorldlie vviſdom, ſeruing only for this vvorld. But the ſecond kind, vvhich is as a ſparkecle of Gods vviſdom, maketh men, othervviſe ignorant and of ſmal capacitie, rightly vviſe in dede, the true ſeruants of God, and enheriters of the kingdom of heauen, as theſe bookes do moſt copiouſly teach.

notes.text: Diuine Attributes are not qualities in God, but his substance.
VVisdom the gifte of the Holie Ghost.

annotations.title: Becauſe I called and you refused.
annotations.text: <mn>[1]</mn> God voutſaffeth foure benefites of grace to euerie man, al neceſſarie and ſufficient for his ſaluation: <mn>[2]</mn> 1. He calleth al by preaching, or good inſpiration. <mn>[3]</mn> 2. He offereth helpe. <mn>[4]</mn> 3. He inſtructeth the ignorant what is good, that they may chooſe it if they wil. <mn>[5]</mn> 4 And reprehendeth euil, that they may shunne it. They therfore that neglect this manifold grace in this life, shal without al remedie be damned, being to late to repent in an other world. For then they shal crie and not be heard. v. 28.

annotations.title: But he that shal heare me.
annotations.text: Contrariwiſe thoſe that accept Gods grace, and cooperate therwith, shal haue eternal reſt and ioy. <mn>◦</mn> The very ſame, which S. Paul teacheth, 2. Cor. 5. v. 10. Euerie one shal receiue the proper thinges of the bodie, according as he hath done, either good or euil.
